verdict.rationale: Qdrant is an API-driven service: it offers a 'convenient API to store, search, and manage points' and exposes ports 6333/6334 in its quickstart. Official client libraries cover Go, Rust, JS/TS, Python, .NET and Java, and the quickstart shows code-driven collection creation. API-key auth with read-only and granular scopes supports programmatic and agent access, and a hands-on user reports smooth onboarding via the Python client. Missing for 10: no API reference page or machine-readable OpenAPI spec in the evidence (probed OpenAPI paths returned 404), and no explicit documentation of the REST/gRPC endpoint surface.
